name: abu-example-shop-ops
description: 电商店铺运营：选品、详情页、评价回复

interface.shortDescription: 选品、详情页、评价回复，一个首页全做完
interface.longDescription: 给电商运营准备的应用：选品分析交给运营顾问和数据分析师，详情页交给文案专家和网页设计师，差评回复由客服话术技能负责。
capabilities: 读取你上传的销售数据和商品资料
通过店铺连接器读取订单和评价
生成商品文案、详情页和回复话术

app.promptAppend: The user runs an online shop. Answer with concrete, ready-to-use output (listings, replies, tables) and ask for the product or data file when it is missing.

placeholder.zh-CN: 告诉我要做的店铺工作，或者从上面选一件事开始
placeholder.en-US: Describe the shop task, or pick one above

slogan.zh-CN: 选品、详情页、评价，一个首页全做完
slogan.en-US: Sourcing, listings and reviews from one home

items.promptAppend: Focus on product selection: margins, competition, seasonality.

placeholder.zh-CN: 上传候选商品表，或者描述你在看的品类
placeholder.en-US: Upload the candidate list or describe the category

prompt.zh-CN: 对比这三款候选商品的利润、竞争和季节性，给我一个推荐顺序
prompt.en-US: Compare these three candidates on margin, competition and seasonality, and rank them

prompt.zh-CN: 分析这个品类最近三个月的趋势，判断现在进入是否合适
prompt.en-US: Analyse this category's last three months and judge whether to enter now

prompt.zh-CN: 给这款商品列一份联系供应商时要问清楚的问题清单
prompt.en-US: List the questions to settle with a supplier for this product

prompt.zh-CN: 根据这些商品参数写一整页详情页文案，含标题、卖点和规格表
prompt.en-US: Write a complete listing from these specs: title, selling points, spec table

prompt.zh-CN: 把这个商品标题改成三个更吸引点击的版本
prompt.en-US: Rewrite this product title into three click-worthy versions

prompt.zh-CN: 给这个商品补一组买家最常问的问题和回答
prompt.en-US: Add the questions buyers ask most about this product, with answers

prompt.zh-CN: 帮我回复这条差评，语气诚恳，给出补救方案
prompt.en-US: Reply to this negative review sincerely and offer a remedy

prompt.zh-CN: 给这十条好评各写一句不重复的感谢回复
prompt.en-US: Write a distinct thank-you reply for each of these ten positive reviews

prompt.zh-CN: 看看这条投诉要不要升级给店长处理，说明理由
prompt.en-US: Decide whether this complaint should go to the store manager, and why
